recognize_zh: 高倍下大量大型組織球有豐富淡染、泡沫狀的細胞質與圓形空泡狀核及小核仁，其中數顆細胞質內可見完整的淋巴球或中性球被包在空隙中（emperipolesis），背景夾雜漿細胞與淋巴球，是 Rosai-Dorfman 病的典型線索。
features: Numerous large histiocytes with abundant pale, foamy to finely vacuolated cytoplasm
Round vesicular nuclei with fine chromatin and small distinct nucleoli
Intact lymphocytes and neutrophils within histiocyte cytoplasm (emperipolesis), often in clear halos
Admixed plasma cells and small lymphocytes in the background
No significant nuclear atypia or atypical mitoses
describe_en: High-power section of lymph node shows sheets of large histiocytes with abundant pale, foamy cytoplasm and round vesicular nuclei with small nucleoli. Several histiocytes contain intact lymphocytes and neutrophils within their cytoplasm, surrounded by clear halos (emperipolesis). Plasma cells and small lymphocytes are admixed, and there is no significant nuclear atypia. Findings are consistent with Rosai-Dorfman disease (sinus histiocytosis with massive lymphadenopathy), to be confirmed by S100 and OCT2 positivity and CD1a negativity.

ddx.vs: LCH cells have grooved, folded coffee-bean nuclei with eosinophil-rich background and are CD1a/langerin positive, lacking prominent emperipolesis.
Ordinary sinus histiocytes are smaller with less abundant cytoplasm, lack emperipolesis and are S100 negative.
Metastatic tumor cells show nuclear pleomorphism, macronucleoli and mitoses and are keratin or melan-A/HMB45 positive rather than bland S100-positive histiocytes engulfing lymphocytes.
